about: Every union arm reachable from LedgerCloseMeta (stellar-xdr v30.0, 499 arms) that no corpus entry reaches, classified with source lines. Arms an entry reaches are not listed here; tools/coverage-report.mjs fails when an arm is in both or in neither.

sources.stellar-core: refs/stellar-core @ f2b9194 (v30.0.0); evidence paths are relative to it unless prefixed

classes.validation-only: set only where a transaction is validated for inclusion; a closed ledger never carries it at protocol 30
classes.not-emitted: in the type graph, but stellar-core 30 never writes it into ledger-close meta
classes.historical: only in ledgers of older protocols (range in the note)
classes.network-only: reachable in closed ledgers, but only under live-network conditions a standalone core cannot set up; to be mined
classes.todo: core can write it at protocol 30 and a standalone recipe can produce it; not yet in an entry

method: First pass by an independent reviewer (Codex) over stellar-core source; every evidence line re-opened and its quote matched; each class checked against every place core sets the code (apply vs check-valid paths); 18 classes corrected (review field).
